evidence.description: DateFormatter is initialized inside the localizedMonthAndYear computed property.

candidates.explanation: The DateFormatter is instantiated inside a computed property that is accessed frequently. DateFormatter is an expensive object to create and should be reused or cached.
candidates.title: Inefficient DateFormatter instantiation

candidates.explanation: Using a hardcoded time zone abbreviation like 'GMT' or 'UTC' can lead to unexpected behavior as these abbreviations can be ambiguous or vary by region. It is safer to use a fixed identifier like 'GMT' or 'UTC'.
candidates.title: Hardcoded TimeZone abbreviation

evidence.description: The data is first decoded as [String: Any] via JSONSerialization, then specific keys are extracted and re-encoded to Data for JSONDecoder.decode(Report.self, from: ...)

candidates.explanation: The code converts data from JSON to a dictionary using JSONSerialization, then converts that dictionary back into Data to decode it into a Report struct using JSONDecoder.
candidates.title: Redundant JSON processing

evidence.description: Optional chaining and nil-coalescing are used on response, keys, and latestObject.

candidates.explanation: The use of optional chaining and nil-coalescing on the response object and its keys means that if the API returns an unexpected format, the app may silently proceed with default or empty values without throwing an error.
candidates.title: Potential for silent failure in data processing

evidence.description: The class provides a shared singleton with mutable properties latestMonth and latestReport.

candidates.explanation: The class uses a shared singleton instance with public internal(set) properties, which can lead to side effects and issues with thread safety when multiple parts of the app access or update the state.
candidates.title: Singleton with mutable state
